title: fix(app-shell): package sheet asks in-app before Delete, Discard and Duplicate (objectui#11784)
body:
Part of #11784

Clause-②: no

The package sheet (`PackageDetailSheet`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`) no longer uses a browser dialog for *Delete app*, *Discard changes* or *Duplicate*. Implemented by the os-dev agent dispatched by the `domain:ui#3` seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`.

## What changed

- **Delete app** opens one in-app `AlertDialog`:
  - a radio between "Delete the structure, keep the records" and "Delete the structure and the data", with nothing preselected;
  - the package name (the one the sheet's title shows) typed to arm the destructive button;
  - a Cancel that sends nothing.

  "Keep the records" sends `DELETE /api/v1/packages/ID?keepData=true`; the other choice sends no query (the spec's `keepData` in `package-api.zod.ts`: preserve object tables, remove metadata only). Before, two `window.confirm` calls ran in a row, and the second one's Cancel sent `?keepData=true`, so Cancel still deleted the structure.
- **Discard changes (N)** asks first, naming the count. Only its confirm calls `/discard-drafts`.
- **Duplicate** replaces `window.prompt` with an inline form built from the Studio landing's own pieces, imported rather than copied: `PackageIdInput` (same sanitizer and format hint), `PACKAGE_ID_RE` (one id rule) and `duplicatePackage` from `studio-design/packages-io.ts`. `BuilderLanding.tsx` is not edited. Because the call is now `duplicatePackage`, a 200 whose duplicate verdict is `success: false` shows as an error, not as "Package duplicated": the sheet's old reader looked only at the envelope's `success`.
- Rows: `deleteConfirm`, `deleteKeepData` and `duplicatePrompt` are removed from both `en` and `zh` designer tables (nothing else read them). The new `engine.packages.detail.*` rows are paired. The duplicate form reuses the landing's `engine.studio.landing.dup*` placeholders and default name, so the sheet's default copy name is now "NAME copy" (it was "NAME (copy)").

No new export, prop, type member or language-pack key. `PackageDetailSheet` keeps its props, and the rows live in app-shell's module-local designer table, which the package root does not re-export.

## Left open: return to `/studio` after a delete

The card's fourth point is **not** in this PR, which is why the first line is `Part of`.

After a delete, the sheet calls `onChanged()` and then `onOpenChange(false)`. Where Studio goes next is decided by the host: `PackageSwitcher`'s `onManageChanged` in `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` refetches the list and, when the managed package is the open one and is gone, navigates to `list[0]` (another package) or to the home path. `StudioDesignSurface.packageDeletionInference.test.tsx` pins that branch ("REAL deletion, a sibling survives: still navigates to that sibling").

The sheet cannot override this without editing the host:
- the host navigates only after its own `fetchPackages()` resolves, so a navigation from the sheet would run first and then be replaced;
- the sheet is also used by the console's `PackagesPage`, where `/studio` is not the right target.

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is not on this claim's surface: objectui#11773 owns it (PR objectui#11826). As the dispatch asks, this half goes back to the seat to sequence. It needs a host-side change of the eviction target plus that pin.

## Tests

A new file, `PackagesPage.confirmFlows-11784.test.tsx`, drives the real `PackageDetailSheet` through a fetch stub that records every request.

- **Delete:**
  - Cancel sends no DELETE, however the question is asked.
  - Cancel after choosing a mode and typing the name sends none.
  - The button stays disabled until a mode is chosen and the name matches. The package id is not accepted as the name.
  - "Structure only" sends `?keepData=true`; "structure and data" sends no query.
  - A refused DELETE keeps the sheet open and shows the refusal.
  - Reopening the dialog starts over.
- **Discard:** the dialog names the count, Cancel sends nothing, and confirm discards once.
- **Duplicate:**
  - The typed id and name are sent.
  - An id that `PACKAGE_ID_RE` refuses never reaches the server.
  - Cancel sends nothing.
  - A false verdict on a 200 is shown as an error.
- **No native dialogs:** spies show no `window.confirm` or `window.prompt` call on the three paths.

**Ablation** (a one-time check, not kept): with the fix committed (`f638af5`), the old two-confirm delete was put back in place of the dialog opener through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit 1 time and the blob moved. After the run, the restored blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

The "Cancel deletes nothing" pin went red on the measured defect itself: it received `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.acme.crm?keepData=true` after the spy answered OK, then Cancel. 7 of 12 pins went red. The 5 that stayed green are the Discard and Duplicate pins, which the mutation does not reach.

## Gates

Final head after merging `origin/main` (two sibling PRs had landed, one touching `i18n.ts`; the merge was clean): `7c0a05e`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project lists the new test file): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new pin file, `PackagesPage.envelopeUserMessage`, `BuilderLanding.orgScope-11553`, `PackageIdInput`, `metadata-form-i18n`, `flowNodePaletteI18n` and the three i18n gate suites (`check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-i18n-dead-keys`, `check-i18n-en-drift`): `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 261 passed (261)`.
- Whole package, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` at `09aa991`, before the last pin and before the merge: `Test Files 1059 passed | 1 skipped (1060)`, `Tests 10376 passed | 9 skipped (10385)`. This run was not repeated after the merge; CI runs the full suite.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source/test files:
  - 0 errors, 17 warnings, 3 files read by eslint's JSON output.
  - `PackagesPage.tsx` alone has 18 warnings at base and 17 at head (one fewer `no-explicit-any`).
  - No type-aware rules: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: exit 0 each.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` (a report) lists no `engine.packages.detail.*` key.

## Acceptance notes

- Not this card: the other native `confirm` / `prompt` / `alert` calls under `app-shell/src/views` stay as they are. That includes `adoptOrphans` on this same sheet (`engine.packages.detail.adoptConfirm`). A `git grep` for `window.confirm(` / `confirm(` style calls under `packages/app-shell/src/views` (tests excluded) also finds:
  - `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`
  - `MetadataTypeActions.tsx`
  - `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (three)
  - `ResourceHistoryPage.tsx`
  - `datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`
  - `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (two)

  That grep is not exhaustive; the card counts by its own reading.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22090 (package *Revert* 404) and its wording are untouched.
- Already there before this PR, not changed here: rendering the sheet with pending drafts logs React's "div cannot be a descendant of p" warning (the `Badge` inside the *Pending changes* paragraph).
- Cost note: the whole-package `vitest run packages/app-shell/` at `--maxWorkers=2` held the shared verify lock for 34m33s.
